name: The Ancient Town of Si Thep and its Associated Dvaravati Monuments
description: Si Thep is an ancient city in Thailand's Phetchabun province, made up of an Inner and Outer Town ringed by moats, plus two nearby monuments: the huge brick mound of Khao Klang Nok and the cave shrine of Khao Thamorrat. Active from roughly the 6th to 10th centuries, it was a major Dvaravati centre where Indian religious ideas blended into a local style of art.
